# Unathi
Unathi are a carnivorous species of tall, scale-covered reptilian beings, they originate from the arid planet of Saaslesh
## Racial Features - They [color=#ffa500]cannot eat vegetables[/color], but [color=#1e90ff]can eat raw meat and drink blood without any ill effects[/color]. - Their blood has a dark red color. - Due to being cold blooded. They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Cold damage[/color]. - They can drag objects with their tail, keeping both their hands free. - Thanks to their claws, they deal [color=red]5[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between 12 and 130 degrees Celcius[/color].
## Draconic The Unathi language, known as Draconic, is composed of a series of sibilant hisses and rattles. Despite its harsh sounds, it is actually one of the easiest languages for other species to learn due to only requiring a tongue to reproduce the sounds necessary.
## Age and Names Unathi are a long lives species, reaching adulthood at 18 years of age and being capable of living up to 200 years. Their names are given to them during the early stages of their life, usually describing one of the typical actions of the hatchling. Most commonly, Unathi names follow the format "(Verb)-the-(Noun)" but it is not uncommon to see names that stray from this pattern.
